mapper.select:
select u.grade as gradeId,cg.title as grade,
count(DISTINCT category${item.sortBy}.id) as category${item.sortBy}Count,
count(DISTINCT u.classs) as classCount
from user u left join score_user su on u.id=su.user_id left join score s on s.id=su.score_id left join `score_score_category` ssc on s.id=ssc.score_id left join `score_category` sc on sc.id=ssc.score_category_id left join course cg on cg.id=u.grade
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sc.* from `score_category` sc where sc.score_category=#{item.id})category${item.sortBy} on category${item.sortBy}.id=sc.id
and u.grade=#{score.grade}
and u.classs in
#{item}
GROUP BY u.grade order by cg.sort_by asc

select u.classs as classsId,cc.title as classs,cg.title as grade,u.grade AS gradeId,
count(DISTINCT category${item.sortBy}.id) as category${item.sortBy}Count,
count(DISTINCT u.id) as userCount
from user u left join score_user su on u.id=su.user_id left join score s on s.id=su.score_id left join `score_score_category` ssc on s.id=ssc.score_id left join `score_category` sc on sc.id=ssc.score_category_id left join course cg on cg.id=u.grade left join course cc on cc.id=u.classs
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sc.* from `score_category` sc where sc.score_category=#{item.id})category${item.sortBy} on category${item.sortBy}.id=sc.id
and u.grade=#{score.grade}
and u.classs in
#{item}
group by u.classs,cg.title ORDER BY cg.sort_by asc,cc.sort_by asc
